## Sidar Kondo

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {3}: Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
- **Flavor text:** Kondo served as guardian to the infant Gerrard and raised him alongside his own son, Vuel. He taught both boys to be strong and to lead, but whereas Gerrard became a champion of honor, Vuel's bitterness led him to become an equally devastating force of malice.
- **Printings:** PVAN/306/01f418f2-3331-570b-a4b5-586742ddd6bf

## Takara

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Sacrifice a creature: Takara deals 1 damage to any target.
- **Flavor text:** Takara banishes the shadow of her father's ignoble reputation through the dedication, plain speaking, and swift action of a warrior. By refusing Starke's path of self-interest and opportunism, she has learned what he never will know: the value of sacrifice for a worthy cause.
- **Printings:** PVAN/308/07fca5bc-4099-5cf4-943c-644fbc075ea6

## Urza

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {3}: Urza deals 1 damage to any target.
- **Flavor text:** An artificer of unparalleled renown, Urza was a powerful cipher even before he was able to planeswalk. Seeing the world as a large, integrated machine is his greatest strength and weakness, enabling him to solve almost any problem but blinding him to his solutions' effects on others.
- **Printings:** PVAN/407/0ae9c76f-5a3a-5174-ae64-13ee2b89af01

## Mirri

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** If a basic land you control is tapped for mana, it produces mana of a color of your choice instead of any other type.
- **Flavor text:** Mirri and Gerrard have been the best of friends since they trained together under the maro-sorcerer Multani. A fierce and agile warrior, she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate shortly after he assumed command of the flying ship.
- **Printings:** PVAN/105/0bcc26c7-1bb2-5830-b4f0-1933857173ee

## Oracle

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {0}: Untap target attacking creature you control and remove it from combat.
- **Flavor text:** Known simply by her title, Oracle uses her gift of prophecy to aid her people. She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny. Her only doubt is whether she will be strong enough to guide him to his destiny.
- **Printings:** PVAN/304/1a34d842-288a-5df9-96e9-2f40064e08a4

## Rofellos

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Whenever a creature you control dies, draw a card.
- **Flavor text:** Gerrard's longtime friend and fellow student under the maro-sorcerer Multani, Rofellos is an excellent warrior and excellent company. Though adept at both magic and swordplay, he's far more comfortable with a flagon in his hand and a good companion at his side.
- **Printings:** PVAN/305/1eaac6b2-36a4-5811-b21b-ac5f4181cc35

## Hanna

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
- **Flavor text:** Educated in Argive and highly knowledgeable in the field of artifacts, this expert navigator of the *Weatherlight* believes that scholarship does not necessarily lead to understanding. Her diligence in pursuing both is her greatest asset.
- **Printings:** PVAN/204/209f4796-46f2-5194-8862-115f48be8177

## Sliver Queen, Brood Mother

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {3}: Create a 1/1 colorless Sliver creature token.
- **Flavor text:** Though long held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold, the sliver queen is actually freer than most of Rath's denizens. Her maternal instincts always take precedence—even when they conflict with the evincar's agenda—and through her numerous litters, she ranges across all of Rath.
- **Printings:** PVAN/307/21107d58-e8cd-50af-95da-d3b82521a34a

## Selenia

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control have vigilance.
- **Flavor text:** Once a guardian of Crovax's estate, Selenia was freed from her magical bindings by the wealthy noble. Instead of remaining at his side, the angel chose to venture out into the world. For reasons unknown to Crovax, Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.
- **Printings:** PVAN/206/36f115b4-f15e-5d38-b7ed-1558e5899e80

## Multani

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control get +X/+0, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
- **Flavor text:** In mentoring apprentice mages, the forest spirit Multani teaches each to respect nature while making use of its gifts. Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines so that both would be improved.
- **Printings:** PVAN/303/3ca1607f-1f1a-59b9-a5c9-fa63cc1ee9f9

## Maraxus

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control get +1/+0.
- **Flavor text:** Too chaotic for even the other warlords of Keld, Maraxus has devoted himself to serving as a hired killer for the sinister Volrath. A man fond of his work, he's more than willing to put in those extra hours needed to perfect his craft.
- **Printings:** PVAN/104/4265d890-e6df-5662-9036-f99b90e5b651

## Crovax

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Whenever a creature you control deals damage to a creature or player, you gain 1 life.
- **Flavor text:** How does one escape a curse? For Crovax, a wealthy noble, the answer may lie in joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay. Secretly, he hopes in his journeys to find Selenia, the angelic being who abandoned him and his family years ago.
- **Printings:** PVAN/202/428c6c62-af2c-5165-a0c4-0fe2a0e5ab84

## Ertai

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control have hexproof. (They can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
- **Flavor text:** After serving his apprenticeship under Barrin of Tolaria, Ertai graced the *Weatherlight* crew with his presence as the ship's "resident" wizard. He realizes that few recognize his greatness—but then how could they, when they lack his insight and wisdom?
- **Printings:** PVAN/101/58caf11c-8564-5675-89db-2d56952be804

## Xantcha

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Sacrifice a permanent: Regenerate target creature.
- **Keywords:** Regenerate
- **Flavor text:** A Phyrexian "sleeper agent," Xantcha has developed an inviolate sense of self. This aberration earned her a death sentence, but she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade. Her Phyrexian credo of "Waste not, want not" has helped Urza more than even he comprehends.
- **Printings:** PVAN/408/6bdb5f14-be26-5885-afb3-a2d0f252408f

## Volrath

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Whenever a creature you control is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may put it on top of your library.
- **Flavor text:** The son of Gerrard's surrogate father, Sidar Kondo, Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece. Now, he is an evincar, or agent, of the Lord of the Wastes. Armed with exceptional magical powers, he plots to conquer the entire multiverse.
- **Printings:** PVAN/208/6f4a2cb1-f97d-594c-9a8d-3f7ace8bf360

## Greven il-Vec

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Whenever a creature you control deals damage to a creature, destroy the other creature. It can't be regenerated.
- **Flavor text:** As a ruthless leader for Volrath, Greven *il*-Vec serves his lord by commanding the flying ship *Predator*. Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations, the majority of which were blessed by Volrath himself.
- **Printings:** PVAN/203/780b5237-f910-579f-9a7c-910f7033c0eb

## Lyna

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control have shadow. (They can block and be blocked only by creatures with shadow.)
- **Flavor text:** One of the few Soltari who can cross the shadow barrier, Lyna serves as an emissary to the outside world. A quick thinker and convincing speaker, she does whatever she can to lead her people out of the shadows and into substance.
- **Printings:** PVAN/302/794ec541-ab84-57d9-b0d4-0cca66912dd2

## Mishra

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** If a creature you control would deal damage, it deals double that damage instead.
- **Keywords:** Double
- **Flavor text:** Both complement and antithesis to his older brother Urza, Mishra also mastered the intricacies of artifice. It was Mishra's strength that first gave rise to the massive Phyrexian war engines on Dominaria, and it was his weakness that pushed him, Urza, and Dominaria itself to the point of annihilation.
- **Printings:** PVAN/403/9e92b468-a24d-572d-8330-42d6f53371c9

## Titania

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
- **Flavor text:** Voice of the Argoth forest, defender of its creatures, and enforcer of its laws, Titania is literally an aspect of the forest itself. Her power and her very existence are linked to the land: when the forest is healthy, Titania is ascendant. When Argoth suffers, Titania also bleeds.
- **Printings:** PVAN/406/abb26080-1a10-5584-80a0-5f5b9e74e101

## Gerrard

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** At the beginning of your draw step, draw an additional card.
- **Flavor text:** Soldier. Adventurer. Heir to the Legacy. Gerrard has, over the years, traveled much of Dominaria in search of fortune and glory. Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence and to take up the battle against the Lord of the Wastes.
- **Printings:** PVAN/102/ad7c6095-ea84-5081-9216-81bf56328758

## Tawnos

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** You may cast artifact, creature, and enchantment spells as though they had flash.
- **Flavor text:** Tawnos brings a childlike wonder and an inherent skill to Urza's studio and bridges the wizardry of the workshop with the grandeur of the royal court. His speed and flexibility quickly earned him promotion from apprentice to master artificer.
- **Printings:** PVAN/405/b306d05f-bc1b-5421-a3c0-20239834f126

## Eladamri

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {0}: The next 1 damage that would be dealt to target creature you control is dealt to you instead.
- **Flavor text:** Proud, shrewd, and charismatic, Eladamri has a commitment to his people that is absolute. The guerilla war he wages against Volrath has convinced him that the only way to liberate the Skyshroud elves is to lead *all* Rath's refugees to freedom. So be it.
- **Printings:** PVAN/301/b7e016bd-2504-5e9b-8855-0c4f5028955b

## Tahngarth

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control have haste.
- **Flavor text:** Tahngarth, first mate of the *Weatherlight* under Sisay, knows that there are really only two forms of life: the ugly ones and the minotaurs. A narcissist, he considers the condition of his hide as important as the accuracy of his blade.
- **Printings:** PVAN/108/bf7682fb-f183-5151-b321-461f4bb3279b

## Orim

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control have reach.
- **Flavor text:** Trained in the Samite arts, Orim serves as the healer aboard the *Weatherlight*. She is quick with languages and was educated at the same Argivian university as Hanna. A student by nature, Orim keeps a diary of all her new discoveries—both physical and spiritual—during her travels.
- **Printings:** PVAN/205/cb55f930-f2a3-567d-88fa-d27f5daab1e5

## Starke

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** At the beginning of your draw step, you may draw an additional card. If you do, put a card from your hand on the bottom of your library.
- **Flavor text:** Starke believes in situational ethics—the situation determines the ethics. He's switched sides so often that he has become everyone's ally yet no one's friend. This former merchant of Rath accompanies the *Weatherlight* crew on their journey to his home world.
- **Printings:** PVAN/207/d3bfaeca-6206-5ed9-8cc4-ad76c65c747d

## Barrin

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Sacrifice a permanent: Return target creature to its owner's hand.
- **Flavor text:** An old and powerful wizard living on the mysterious isle of Tolaria, Barrin is the teacher who trained the young Ertai. He is also Hanna's father, but for reasons known only to the two of them neither acknowledges the other—or their strained relationship.
- **Printings:** PVAN/201/d4675d0d-2865-5c08-920c-9e8d33d9b886

## Gix

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** {3}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
- **Flavor text:** Through ruthlessness and raw ambition, Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor. Even while overseeing many of Phyrexia's most important undertakings, Gix continues his own quest for supremacy . . . for in Phyrexia, the weak become fodder for the strong.
- **Printings:** PVAN/402/d6e2085b-182d-5279-a2e5-4f7086f74960

## Squee

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Your opponents play with their hands revealed.
- **Flavor text:** The smartest—and only—goblin cabin boy aboard the *Weatherlight*, Squee has learned that intelligence and common sense are very different things. This matters little, however, since he has neither. Fortunately, he doesn't know what he's missing.
- **Printings:** PVAN/107/d7ee18e1-525b-56d6-ba45-a318ad7a0f92

## Ashnod

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Whenever a creature deals damage to you, destroy it.
- **Flavor text:** Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War. Whereas Mishra works in metals and stone, however, Ashnod works in living flesh. She sees all living things as prototype machines; her "improvements" to them make her as feared by allies as by enemies.
- **Printings:** PVAN/401/eace690c-91c5-5da5-8dcf-15807a09a1df

## Serra

- **Type:** Vanguard
- **Rules text:** Creatures you control get +0/+2.
- **Flavor text:** Named for a benevolent goddess at birth, Serra fulfilled the prophecy of that goddess's coming. As a planeswalker, she embodies white mana and helps whole civilizations develop while both directly and indirectly inspiring countless individuals to be steadfast and strong in the service of light.
- **Printings:** PVAN/404/ef4f8fb9-3e8f-51d5-81a7-d8f805cec6ee

## Karn

- **Flavor text:** Both part of the Legacy and an individual in his own right, the silver golem Karn is haunted by a single, terrible incident: while serving to protect the young Gerrard, Karn accidentally took the life of another. Wakened from years spent as a statue, the golem has vowed to never kill again as he rejoins Gerrard.

## Sisay
